verdict.rationale: Zapier documents programmatic access through a Workflow API for powering automations and AI workflows, an npm SDK that authenticates with OAuth or client credentials and executes actions across 9,000+ apps, and REST-style endpoints such as /stored-actions in its LLM-oriented docs, which together let an agent drive the product. Coverage of the API surface itself is thin: no OpenAPI spec was found at any probed path, and the evidence centers on executing actions rather than managing Zaps or workflows themselves. missing for 10: machine-readable OpenAPI/reference spec, evidence of API control over Zap/workflow management, independent or hands-on corroboration of the API.
